caption: The drawing depicts a wooden shelving unit composed of rectangular sections. The unit consists of two shelves: one upper open shelf and one lower shelf that sits above a drawer. The shelves and the frame are depicted in a medium brown wood color, with grain and shading to indicate wood texture. The lower portion of the unit contains a horizontal drawer with two small round knobs, colored in gold or brass tones. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details. The structure is mainly outlined and shaded to suggest dimensionality, with the lines drawn in darker brown or black to create clear separation between the wooden surfaces.
title: Hanging Shelf
